## Lunch breaks

 All employees are encouraged to take a lunch break during the day. Generally, your offer letter will state
 the number of hours you’re expected to work weekly. Lunch breaks will not count toward that amount of time.
 Some other notes about lunch breaks:

- Please eat in the kitchen or equivalent, to keep workspace equipment and furniture clean

- Preferably eat with others to get to know teammates better

- You’re more than welcome to leave the office to eat at local restaurants
